long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (a != 0 && b != 0) {
        long long c = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = c;
    }
    return a + b;
}

int maxMatching(const std::vector<std::vector<bool>> &graph) {
    int n1 = (int)graph.size();
    int n2 = n1 > 0 ? (int)graph[0].size() : 0;
    std::vector<int> matching(n2, -1);
    int matches = 0;

    std::function<bool(int, std::vector<bool>&)> findPath = [&](int u1, std::vector<bool> &vis) {
        vis[u1] = true;
        for (int v = 0; v < n2; v++) {
            int u2 = matching[v];
            if (graph[u1][v] && (u2 == -1 || (!vis[u2]) && findPath(u2, vis))) {
                matching[v] = u1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    };

    for (int u = 0; u < n1; u++) {
        std::vector<bool> vis(n1, false);
        if (findPath(u, vis))
            ++matches;
    }
    return matches;
}

int bruteforce(int n, int m) {
    std::vector<Point> even, odd;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            int sum = i + j;
            if (sum % 2 == 0) {
                even.emplace_back(i, j);
            } else {
                odd.emplace_back(i, j);
            }
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::vector<bool>> match(even.size(), std::vector<bool>(odd.size(), false));
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)even.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)odd.size(); j++) {
            int d = abs(even[i].x - odd[j].x) + abs(even[i].y - odd[j].y);
            if (d == 3) {
                match[i][j] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    return 2 * maxMatching(match);
}

void solve() {
    n = nextInt();
    m = nextInt();
    if (n > m) {
        std::swap(n, m);
    }

    if (n == 1) {
        m--;
        int left[] = {0, 0, 0, 2, 4, 6};
        long long res = (m / 6) * 6 + left[m % 6];
        outln(res);
        return;
    } else if (n == 2) {
        if (m < 20) {
            outln(bruteforce(n, m));
        } else {
            outln(1LL * n * m);
        }
        return;
    } else if (n == 3) {
        if (m < 20) {
            outln(bruteforce(n, m));
        } else {
            long long res = 1LL * n * m;
            if (res % 2 != 0) res--;
            outln(res);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (1LL * n * m < 1000) {
        outln(bruteforce(n, m));
        return;
    }
    long long res = 1LL * n * m;
    if (res % 2 != 0) res--;
    outln(res);
}

int main() {

    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
